Proofs

Questions of the mind

The questions a thinking person asks before any book is opened: existence, design, reason, meaning, suffering. Each is answered as an argument first.

99 questions

The ground

  • Why is there anything at all, instead of nothing?
  • If everything needs a maker, who made God?
  • Is there a sign of God inside me?
  • If my reason evolved to survive, why trust it?
  • Would hurting a child be wrong if all approved?
  • Hasn't science made God unnecessary?
  • What evidence would be enough for me to believe?
  • If God wants my belief, why doesn't He appear?
  • How can a good God allow children to suffer?
  • With no God, can my life still mean anything?
  • What was I made for?
  • Why one God, not many gods or a blind force?
  • Is there one God behind all the names?
  • Is the true God beyond what people worship?
  • Did the Buddha point to what is never born?
  • What can I lean on that will never fade?
  • Is anyone really listening, or is it a feeling?
  • Isn't the burden of proof on whoever claims?
  • Did religion just evolve in the human brain?
  • Why would a perfect being need worship?
  • Isn't morality just something humans made up?
  • Does God command what is good, or make it good?
  • How can I tell for myself what is true?
  • Why do I feel guilty for doubting?
  • How does God see me, beyond all the debates?
  • Why trust anything I haven't seen for myself?
  • Can many weak arguments add up to anything?
  • Can't the universe just exist for no reason?
  • Is human dignity real, or just an agreement?
  • Does revelation mean switching off my reason?
  • Why would a holy book ask for evidence?
  • How sure do I need to be before I believe?

  • How do I find rest when my mind won't stop?

  • Is there really wisdom in every hardship?
  • Why doesn't God stop people from doing harm?
  • I tried to be good. Why did this happen to me?
  • What did a child ever do to deserve this?
  • Is an earthquake a punishment from God?
  • Is patience just being told to keep quiet?
  • Do I owe thanks for a life I did not ask for?
  • Does God give reasons for His commands?
  • Is good only good because God says so?
  • If we are animals, why is human life sacred?
  • I have no hope left. Can it come back?
  • Must I give up remembering my ancestors?
